description: #53: writes each section's summary with llm.complete on the OpenAI-compatible lobes gateway (model cortex-spark2; never the gateway's default model). No bridge, no tools, no repo. Shares the qwen-spark2 pool with the PR fixer, so a summary waits behind a running fix. base_url is spark's loopback: the action runs where the actor lives (machine spark); on another machine set the gateway's LAN address.
name: Daily newspaper: summaries (cortex)
